rationale: A third party (minor child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's property due to an icy walkway condition, which is a classic premises liability scenario covered under homeowners liability.
claim_summary: Third party (nine-year-old neighbor's daughter) suffered a broken wrist after slipping and falling on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm last week. Parents are addressing medical bills. This is a premises liability claim requiring prompt adjuster contact to manage medical expenses and potential settlement.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Slip and fall on icy walkway during ice storm
